entries.design: A thick crescent-shaped shark steak cut, pink salmon flesh with a small cream cartilage center and slate blue skin rim matching this shark. Food cut, no whole animal.
entries.raw_prompt: Create one Minecraft inventory food item sprite, based on the attached actual textured mob model preview (reference for anatomy/colors only). A thick crescent-shaped shark steak cut, pink salmon flesh with a small cream cartilage center and slate blue skin rim matching this shark. Food cut, no whole animal. Crisp deliberate pixel art, limited palette, chunky stepped silhouette and square pixel shading suitable for downscaling to exactly 64x64. Center one isolated icon on square canvas, 10% clear padding, same overhead three-quarter inventory lighting, no text, labels, UI, floor, cast shadow, plate, garnish, or background. Truly transparent background. This is the RAW food version.
entries.cooked_prompt: Edit this RAW Minecraft food sprite into its COOKED version. Treat the supplied raw icon as the edit target. Preserve EXACT same outer silhouette, cutout/holes, position, canvas, orientation, volume and transparent alpha boundary. ONLY recolor/shade interior pixels to cooked food. Turn raw pink flesh to warm golden tan cooked flesh, dark brown toasted edges, a few subtle brown grill stripes; keep skin rim recognizable but browned. Crisp square pixel art matching reference, not smooth painting. No steam, garnish, extra outline, plate, cast shadow, text or background. Transparent background. Identical silhouette is essential.
